name: How long does a typical window replacement project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical window replacement project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a window replacement project varies significantly based on the number of windows, their type, and the complexity of the installation. For a whole-home remodel that includes window replacement, the timeline will be integrated into the broader project schedule. Generally, individual window replacements can take a few days to a week or more for larger projects. AKN Design Group provides transparent scheduling and clear communication throughout the managed process, offering upfront estimates on project duration.
